policy: Fail on every unreviewed critical production dependency and every expired acceptance.

acceptedCriticalFindings.mitigation: The only registered HTTP middleware is request logging from nestjs-pino. Authentication, rate limiting, tenant isolation, metrics access, validation, and error handling are implemented as guards, pipes, filters, and controllers rather than path-scoped middleware. Upgrade remediation remains required before this acceptance expires.
